_meta.description: Maps Vanilla-JavaScript conventions (no SPA framework — addEventListener / dispatchEvent, window.* namespaces) to Spashta CKG Semantic Roles. The JS sibling of the HTMX adapter: rule-based, deterministic, additive; it annotates roles on nodes the JS builder already emits, it never mutates structure.
_meta.applies_to: Projects using plain browser JavaScript (the Forms Portal stack: HTMX + vanilla JS + a window.fp public API). Activate by adding "vanilla" to project/profile.json frameworks.
_meta.requires_builder: builders/js/build_js_ast.py (>= the event-coupling slice — emits registers_event_handler / dispatches_event edges).

mappings.notes: A function that registers an event handler (addEventListener) or dispatches an event (dispatchEvent) IS an event handler/producer — the CKG `Signal` role. Detected purely from the edges the JS builder emits, exactly like the HTMX adapter detects Component via calls_api/triggers_event/submits_form.
